The only candidate and an exact name, compartment and unit match.
None of the candidates is dinitrogen monoxide (N2O): they are all carbon monoxide or lead monoxide variants, and mapping N2O to CO would be a different substance. The line is reported as missing.

'Methane (biogenic)' to air is the same substance, origin and compartment; the fossil variant has a different origin, the correction flow is a timing artefact and the rest are unrelated sulphur or ester compounds.
'Carbon Dioxide (land Use Change)' as an emission to air is the land-transformation CO2 the reservoir releases from flooded biomass; candidate 1 is the same flow as an uptake from air.

Waste heat released to air, the compartment the table gives (no sub-compartment stated).

'Water' to air in cubic metres is the evaporation from the reservoir the table describes; sea water, green water, water vapour in kilograms and the evapotranspiration flux are narrower or differently defined, and the two long chemical names are unrelated substances.

'Oils, Unspecified' is the right substance for the lubricating-oil spill from the turbines. This dataset has TWO such lines, one to river water and one to industrial soil, which share the flow name, so the compartment is left to each line item rather than fixed here.
